old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a clear plastic bag partially covering a cluster of green leaves. The bag is slightly crumpled, allowing some light to filter through, creating a soft, diffused illumination on the leaves beneath. Water droplets are visible on both the bag and the leaves, indicating recent rain or dew. The camera remains stationary, focusing on the interaction between the bag and the leaves. The text overlay at the bottom of the frame reads, "These will start to run down the sides of the bag and collect in the lowest point," suggesting an educational or instructional purpose, possibly explaining how water collects in a bag after rainfall. The overall scene is serene and natural, emphasizing the simple yet intricate details of the environment.

caption: The video captures a close-up view of several green, lance-shaped leaves enclosed behind a transparent plastic sheet whose inner surface is coated with condensation. A fine mist of tiny droplets spreads across the upper-left region, while scattered larger beads and a few elongated drips cling to the film, including one prominent hanging droplet near the right-center. The leaves, stems, and droplet pattern show no visible change in position or camera framing. The only visible change is a white sans-serif caption that gradually emerges over the lower portion of the image. It is absent at first, becomes faintly legible, and then settles into full opacity, reading that the droplets will run down the sides of the bag and collect in the lowest point. That described motion is not visible; the physical scene shows no movement while the overlay text fades in and holds steady.
